body:
Measured current tag catalogs in release on M4/macOS 27 using ordinary synthetic source reads and exact result checks. Guarded filesystem reading dominates ordinary-file parsing/validation. A bounded allocation hint saves only 0.21–0.45 ms for 1,000 ordinary cards and reverses in the global 100-project/10,000-card/50,000-report repeat. Paired worker handoff regresses dense project medians from 33.81 to 39.33 ms and global median from 430.34 to 488.06 ms. Both prototypes and the temporary example are restored.

Documentation/package validation passes. Application source and the existing manual instance remain unchanged; trusted HTTPS still serves the same verified root. No new full-gate, browser, physical-device or deployment result is claimed for rejected code. The owner's unrelated card edit is preserved. The optional Python Omarchy helper's up-to-six-read status path, despite available Focus summaries, is a concrete next investigation. Broader performance and release acceptance remain open.

metadata.summary: Tag source allocation and handoff probes rejected after release measurement
